Toolkit: 18 specialists; shared RuleSync rules, commands, hooks, MCP; compatible with GitHub Copilot CLI. Support is asymmetric: author shared behavior once, target blocks only where runtime differs. Distributed via RuleSync; see documentation for installation.

Tab cycles **primary** agents only. `<REDACTED_USER>` invokes subagents. `dotnet-architect` is a primary OpenCode agent. Gemini CLI inherits shared .NET routing and receives generated post-edit Roslyn, formatting, and Slopwatch advisories. Factory Droid consumes generated .NET session/MCP routing; hooks remain runtime-compatible.

If RuleSync reports `Multiple root rulesync rules found`, ensure only one root overview rule exists. Use RuleSync commands directly instead of manually reproducing catalog, prompt, incident, or graph logic.
